# tfcensus move

move runs migration files: migration "units" blocks that move resources from one unit's state
to others, or run tfmigrate-style mv, xmv and rm actions inside one state. The file format and a full
walkthrough are at https://tfcensus.sasskovacs.dev/guides/move.

suggest drafts a migration file from plans. plan and status only read. apply, rollback and mark-applied are the only tfcensus commands that
write to a backend; each asks you to type the block's destination unit path first, or takes
--yes. Without a terminal and without --yes they exit 2 and change nothing.

Exit codes: 3 when a block is rejected, 4 when the backend credentials fail, 2 for a file or flag
error or a missing confirmation, and 1 for any other failure.

Unit paths in the file are relative to --repo (default: the current directory) and name units
with an s3 backend. Write path:workspace for a workspace other than default, such as
live/app:blue; the state is then read from &lt;workspace\_key\_prefix&gt;/&lt;workspace&gt;/&lt;key&gt; (env: when
the backend sets no prefix), and terragrunt runs with TF\_WORKSPACE. The workspace must exist.
The native strategy works on the default workspace only.

## Usage

```sh
tfcensus move <command>
```

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Examples

```sh
tfcensus move suggest --from live/network --to live/vpc --draft migrations/split_network.hcl
tfcensus move plan migrations/split_network.hcl
tfcensus move apply migrations/split_network.hcl --yes
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [tfcensus move apply](/cli/move/apply) | Apply a migration file to the units' states |
| [tfcensus move mark-applied](/cli/move/mark-applied) | Record migration blocks as applied without changing state |
| [tfcensus move plan](/cli/move/plan) | Verify a migration file with plans, without writing anything |
| [tfcensus move rollback](/cli/move/rollback) | Restore the states a migration file changed |
| [tfcensus move status](/cli/move/status) | Show whether each migration block is applied in each unit |
| [tfcensus move suggest](/cli/move/suggest) | Draft a migration file from the moves that plans show |
